name: Rider
description: A customer who hails and pays for trips through the ECT Rider app.

name: Driver
description: A licensed operator who accepts and completes trips via the ECT Driver app.

name: Trip
description: A single completed journey from pickup to dropoff, with fare and payment.

name: TLC License
description: The NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission license number that authorizes a driver to operate.

name: Cardholder Data
description: Data elements defined by PCI DSS: Primary Account Number (PAN), cardholder name, and expiry.

name: Trip Survey
description: Rider feedback on a completed trip, including a rating and free-text comment.

name: Payout
description: A payment made to a driver for completed trips, routed to their bank account.

name: PII
description: Information that identifies or can identify a specific individual, alone or combined.

name: Sensitive PII
description: PII that, if disclosed, creates significant harm risk (e.g., SSN, background check).

name: Location Data
description: Pickup/dropoff zones which, tied to a rider, reveal a person's movements.

name: Financial Data
description: Data describing fares, payouts, revenue, or financial position.

name: Secret Data
description: Highest classification (Tier 1): regulated identifiers such as SSN, cardholder data, financial account data, and credentials. Never used in analytics or non-production.

name: Confidential Data
description: Tier 2: regulated or high-harm personal data and sensitive HR data (contact details, TLC license, background checks, compensation, precise locations).

name: Sensitive Data
description: Tier 3: basic personal data (names) and business or financial data whose disclosure would harm ECT, a rider, or a driver.

name: Internal Data
description: Tier 4: operational data intended for internal use; low harm if disclosed.

name: Public Data
description: Tier 5: data approved for public release; no restriction.

name: Data Owner
description: Accountable executive/role for a data domain; approves access and classification.

name: Data Steward
description: Operational role responsible for day-to-day data quality and definitions within a domain.

name: Data Custodian
description: Technical role (e.g., Platform/SRE) that implements storage and controls for the data.
